name: Thuringia
summary: Two horizontal bands of white over red. The colours come from the striped lion of the medieval Ludovingian landgraves; the state flag adds the arms with the lion and eight stars.
origin: The state was re-established in 1990 and adopted its flag in 1991. The striped lion, shared historically with Hesse, comes from the Ludovingian landgraves of Thuringia.
facts: Its colours are the reverse of Hesse's.
Poland's national flag is also white over red.
clues: White over red, two horizontal bands.
The reverse of a neighbouring German state's colours.
Its state arms show a striped lion with eight stars.
